admission_question: Do at least three frozen images expose a current-view repeated-post pedestrian glass-door bank for which one functional portal-set region can be boxed before algorithm execution?
stop_rule: Materialize all six once, inspect pixels once, freeze every evaluable portal-set box, and run the unchanged v2 lattice algorithm only if at least three frames are evaluable.
fresh_gate: Top-3 portal-set membership must be at least two thirds and strictly exceed zero recall. Top-1, proposal count, and box completeness are descriptive. Run once without tuning.
claim_boundary: A passing result evaluates only current-image glass-door-bank proposal retention. It does not establish requested-entity identity, access, traversability, temporal tracking, guidance, arrival, benefit, or safety.
